title: PlannerSetupProgressRequest
description: Body of `POST /setup/{projectKey}/progress` on the backlog-planner: Factory reports ONE step of the project's setup task ('task 0'). Same shape as one `factory.handover-setup` step, minus the server-set `at`. `reason` (closed code) is required when `state` is `failed`, and `reason`/`detail` are refused on any other state. Replaying an identical report changes nothing and writes no second comment. Answers: `planner.setup-progress-response` or `planner.setup-error`.

step.description: Closed set: `app-repo` creates the app repository, `hexagon-repo` the hexagon repository, `onboard` onboards the app, `register-project` registers the project, `verify-discovery` checks the platform discovers it.

state.description: `skipped` is the state of `app-repo` and `hexagon-repo` when `localOnly` is true.

reason.description: Closed short code, present when `state` is `failed`.

detail.description: Free text for the reason; never a secret.
